customer_message.subject: Defect in rented flat Seestrasse 85, Baden - request for assistance
customer_message.body:
Dear Legal Expenses Team,

I am writing to request your help with a defect in my rented flat at Seestrasse 85, Baden, a 4.5-room flat rented from Regimo Liegenschaften AG. I have lived here since the start of my tenancy and have reported the problems to the landlord in writing.

There is mould growth and persistent damp patches on the walls of the children's room. The stains have been spreading over the past several months. In addition, the heating does not work properly: several radiators stay cold or fail completely, and the flat cools down to about 16 degrees at times.

I notified Regimo Liegenschaften AG of both problems, but the landlord has not repaired them so far. I would like your advice on how to proceed and whether you can cover the costs of a lawyer to help me enforce the landlord's repair obligation.

I am happy to send photos of the mould, the damp areas and the radiators, as well as copies of my correspondence with the landlord. Please let me know which documents you need and what the next steps are.

Thank you for your support.

Kind regards,
Jordan Reid
